what_happened: The route command was LEFT, but after handoff the ego veered right, off the recorded path, into the next lane behind the slow grey van (actor 13). It slowed from about 4 to 1.9 m/s but not enough to stop: the gap closed from 8 m to contact, and its front hit the van's rear at 8.1 s.

In slow queued traffic, the ego crept forward behind stopped lead car 24 and slowed from 1.8 to 0.4 m/s, but never came to a full stop. It touched the lead car's rear at walking pace (a front collision at 9.6 s), about 3.3 m off the recorded human path.

After handoff, the ego was told to go RIGHT but slowed from 17 to 7 m/s while steering steadily left across the lanes, ending up 11.5 m from the human path. At 7.9 s it reached the left road edge, headed off the road, and its right side scraped vehicle 32, which was in the adjacent lane.

When the command changed to RIGHT near the intersection, the ego didn't follow the recorded path to the right. It kept going straight and drifted left while slowing from about 18 to 12 m/s, and ran up onto the landscaped median with bushes at 7.0 s, about 6.8 m off the recorded path.

On a multi-lane highway with a STRAIGHT command (LEFT by the end), the policy steered right out of its lane, away from the recorded path, which stayed straight and then went slightly left. Its front struck vehicle 3, which was traveling alongside and slightly ahead in the adjacent right lane, at about 6.6 m/s.

After the 4.6 s handoff, the ego slowed from about 11 to 7 m/s and steered left across several lanes of the freeway. It did this even though the command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT, and the recorded path stays to the right. At 7.1 s it was about 6 m off that path and made side contact with actor 28, which was in the lane it was moving into.

The road split ahead and the route went right (the command changed to RIGHT and the recorded path curves right). After handoff, the ego kept going straight and drifted left at about 17–21 m/s. It ran onto the median between the two roadways, about 4 m off the recorded path, while a vehicle behind it on the right made contact.
